mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY > 2% does not lead to tighter monetary policy or if S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the cases.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) indicates weakening consumer demand, which negatively impacts corporate earnings and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS decreases do not correlate with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a weakening labor market, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE increases do not lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in Industrial Production (INDPRO) signals a slowdown in economic activity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO decreases do not lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals an easing monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS decreases do not lead to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts (HOUST) signals strengthening consumer demand, which positively impacts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST increases do not lead to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) combined with a decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a strengthening labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the combined signal does not lead to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in GDP (GDPC1) combined with an increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) signals stagflation, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the combined signal does not lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
